rows.label: tlk70000047_02_msg0001
rows.name:
Oh, what should I do...? I never
thought the capital would end up like
this...

rows.label: tlk70000047_02_msg0002
rows.name:
God of Acedia... Please protect us...
Please, at least protect my daughter
Furia!

rows.label: tlk70000047_02_msg0003
rows.name:
No, this is no time to pray... For
Furia's sake, I have to stay strong!

rows.label: tlk70000047_02_msg0004
rows.name:
Don't worry about us. Your energy is
better spent helping the injured or
assisting with rebuilding efforts.
